display.purpose: Place-led Home cover and chapter headings.

label.purpose: Station codes, timestamps, and measurement values.

motion.name: ease-brand
motion.purpose: Section reveals and larger object movement.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled primary action with a visible keyboard focus ring.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: var(--h-brand-blue); color: var(--h-canvas); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color var(--motion-base, 190ms) var(--ease-standard, ease); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--h-brand-blue) 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a light rule and a shared focus ring.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--h-border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: transparent; color: var(--h-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color var(--motion-base, 190ms) var(--ease-standard, ease); } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--h-wash-hover); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-outline:active { background: var(--h-wash-active); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quieter action with no resting surface.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: transparent; color: var(--h-foreground-muted); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color var(--motion-base, 190ms) var(--ease-standard, ease); } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: var(--h-wash-hover); color: var(--h-foreground); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-ghost:active { background: var(--h-wash-active); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Full-width paper field with shared rounded shape and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--h-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--h-border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: var(--h-canvas); color: var(--h-foreground); font: 400 16px/1.4 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--h-foreground-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .55; }

components.name: Active Header Link
components.description: Compact route link with an underline for the current location.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--h-foreground-muted); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--motion-base, 190ms) var(--ease-standard, ease), background-color var(--motion-base, 190ms) var(--ease-standard, ease); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--h-wash-hover); color: var(--h-foreground); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--h-brand-blue); } .ds-nav-active::after { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 5px; left: 12px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; content: ''; }

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Compact semantic label for an unverified or warning state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--h-warning) 32%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); background: var(--h-warning-bg); color: var(--h-warning); font: 600 11px/1.3 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); }

components.name: Cover Title Rows
components.description: Place-led cover with exactly two intentional title lines and one action.
components.html:
CỒN HÔ · VĨNH LONG

This is Cồn Hô.This is HORIZON.

Three field points record water, soil, and the data link at Cồn Hô.

View the monitoring network →
components.css: .ds-cover { min-height: 360px; padding: 48px 32px 24px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(12,29,26,.83), rgba(12,29,26,.48) 45%, rgba(12,29,26,.04) 85%), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(12,29,26,.3), transparent 60%); color: #fffaf0; } .ds-cover-place { margin-bottom: 24px; color: #ece5d2; font: 11px/1.5 var(--font-data, ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-cover h1 { font: 450 clamp(48px, 7.5vw, 96px)/1.08 var(--font-editorial, Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-cover h1 span { display: block; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-cover-copy { max-width: 42ch; margin-top: 28px; color: #f0ebdd; font: 400 16px/1.65 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-cover-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; margin-top: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #afa994; color: #fffaf0; font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-cover-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-cover-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-cover { padding: 56px 20px 20px; } .ds-cover h1 { font-size: clamp(32px, 8.4vw, 61px); } }

components.name: Station Register
components.description: Geography-linked station selection for the Observatory instrument.
components.css: .ds-station-register { margin: 20px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-station-register button { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 88px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--h-border); color: var(--h-foreground); text-align: left; } .ds-station-register button[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--h-selection-surface); } .ds-station-register code { color: var(--h-brand-blue); font: 500 11px/1.5 var(--font-data, ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-station-register button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Station Instrument Reading
components.description: Selected station value with unit and available provenance context.
components.css: .ds-reading { min-width: 0; padding: 20px 0; border-block: 1px solid var(--h-border-strong); } .ds-reading dt { color: var(--h-foreground-muted); font: 400 12px/1.4 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-reading dd { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--h-foreground); font: 400 clamp(44px, 6vw, 80px)/1.25 var(--font-data, ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-reading small { font-size: 13px; } .ds-reading p { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--h-foreground-muted); font: 400 11px/1.5 var(--font-data, ui-monospace, monospace); }

components.name: Operations Selector
components.description: Touch-sized mobile selector for every Admin workflow section.
components.css: .ds-operations-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--h-foreground-muted); font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-operations-select { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--h-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--h-canvas); color: var(--h-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-interface, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-operations-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--h-brand-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
HORIZON is grounded in the real field system at Cồn Hô: its geography, commissioned illustration and documentary media, sensor stations, gateway, and observations. Keep the existing project identity. The cover can carry the creative expression; the working tools favor quiet surfaces, aligned edges, and legible records.

The home story connects place, hardware, geography, the data path, agricultural questions, and community reports. The Observatory behaves like a station-scoped scientific instrument, the Report flow like a progressive field notebook, and Admin like a compact operations console. Use the same warm canvas, editorial and interface type, station identifiers, and data provenance across these distinct tasks.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet warm canvas with documentary media and a two-row Cồn Hô cover.
Connected engineering path shown as a dark, numbered diagram.
Observatory measurements and trend follow the selected station.
Report evidence and administrative navigation are designed for task completion on phones and desktop.

rules.name: The Brand Is Not Data Rule
rules.body: HORIZON green and orange identify the mark; status and chart colors encode their own meanings.

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep cover and diagram tones on those specific surfaces. Do not use them as generic status colors.

rules.name: The Three Registers Rule
rules.body: Use Newsreader for editorial titles, Be Vietnam Pro for prose and controls, and Roboto Mono for identifiers and readings.

rules.name: The Diagram Carries the Grid Rule
rules.body: Keep the global canvas quiet; geography and the connected diagram provide the spatial structure.

dos: Do use the existing Cồn Hô illustration, commissioned media, equipment photographs, and geography as the source of the visual story.
Do keep the cover title to its two authored rows and lead with place, context, and Observatory action.
Do preserve station identity: `STATION_01` water, `STATION_02` soil and microclimate, `STATION_03` gateway location/role, and `GATEWAY_01` the technical gateway.
Do keep each Observatory reading tied to its selected station and preserve source, time, freshness, and quality when provided.
Do keep demo readings explicitly marked and external context attributed separately from HORIZON telemetry.
Do keep location, observation, and evidence visible together on one report page, with the existing three-file combined media limit.
Do retain visible focus, responsive navigation, and outdoor touch targets.
donts: Don't add station counts or a second system register to the cover.
Don't invent measurements, status, thresholds, recommendations, field validation, or device acknowledgements.
Don't treat missing data as zero, external weather as HORIZON telemetry, EC as salinity, or bulk soil EC as ECe.
Don't imply that stored configuration or calibration records prove device receipt, calibration, or execution.
Don't let the connected stream dot read as a device-health indicator.
Don't add a decorative global grid; keep spatial geometry in maps and the connected data path.
